Q&A

Questions & answers

How much does it cost?

There are five all-you-can-eat courses: Yoka ¥2,980, Unmaka ¥3,480, Satsuma ¥3,980, Oyattosa ¥4,480 and Wazze ¥5,980 (per person, tax included). Each runs 120 minutes, with orders taken for the first 90.

Can we come without a reservation?

Yes, but we cannot seat you when we are full. Booking by phone (+81-99-295-0145) is the sure way; same-day bookings are welcome.

Do you accept UnionPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay?

Yes. We also accept Visa, Mastercard, JCB, Amex, Diners and Discover, PayPay and other QR payments, and transit IC cards.

More questions
